rules.description: Block common Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and database query injection patterns in request strings
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "<script>" or http.request.uri.query contains "javascript:" or http.request.uri.query contains "$") or (http.request.body.mime eq "application/json" and (http.request.uri.path contains "/api/" and (http.request.body.raw contains "$gt" or http.request.body.raw contains "$ne")))

rules.description: Prevent directory traversal and unauthorized relative file system path attacks
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains ".." or http.request.uri.path contains "etc/passwd" or http.request.uri.path contains "proc/self")

rules.description: Apply strict challenge tokens to public config file requests and exposed metrics paths
